stdout:
Create a comment thread. Use this tool to create a comment thread.

Usage:
  yutu commentThread insert [flags]

Examples:
# Post a comment on a video
yutu commentThread insert --channelId UC_x5X --videoId dQw4w9WgXcQ --authorChannelId UA_x5X --textOriginal 'Great video!'
# Post a comment with JSON output
yutu commentThread insert --channelId UC_x5X --videoId dQw4w9WgXcQ --authorChannelId UA_x5X --textOriginal 'Nice work!' --output json

Flags:
  -a, --authorChannelId string   Channel id of the comment author
  -c, --channelId string         Channel id of the video owner
  -h, --help                     help for insert
  -o, --output string            json|yaml|silent
  -t, --textOriginal string      Text of the comment
  -v, --videoId string           ID of the video
      --yes                      Confirm the operation
